notes:
Rumble's Scrap Shield is a flat 6 seconds at EVERY rank (champ-data/_kits/rumble.json), yet this entry is built end to end around 'track Scrap Shield before every commit'. That is the worst advice in the matchup and it is load-bearing: full.focus.text is 'Rumble Scrap Shield' and focus.letters is ['W'], which is what the loading screen prints. Those two need a manual write together (something like 'Rumble heat bar' with letters ['P']) — I did not propose it because focus.letters is a single-element array and I cannot verify the renderer accepts 'P' as a valid token.

The suspectName 'Drop Equalizer' was a REAL hit, not a false positive: Riot's name is The Equalizer.

'Between the Worlds' (extra 'the') appears in the full layer for Aurora's own R; Riot's name is Between Worlds. Worth grepping repo-wide.

The Equalizer carries a 'terrain' derived flag, but Riot's description is a wall of flames that damages and slows and does not block movement. rumble__aurora.json reached the same conclusion independently. Trust the description; the flag misfires.

Deliberately not asserted: whether Across the Veil's invisibility stops Equalizer ticks or breaks Flamespitter re-acquisition. Riot's text says invisible, not untargetable, and aurora.json needsResearch is empty — that needs a wiki pass, not an inference.
